roadmap.title: Base campaign
roadmap.description: Play the base game through Lilith and the epilogue.

roadmap.title: Early levelling and side systems
roadmap.description: Level a character to 50, learn crafting, make one Hardcore and one character for each class objective, and explore Estuar.

roadmap.title: Vessel of Hatred
roadmap.description: Finish the Vessel of Hatred campaign, explore Nahantu, and unlock Mercenaries.

roadmap.title: Lord of Hatred
roadmap.description: Finish the Lord of Hatred campaign, explore Skovos, fish, and unlock War Plans and the Horadric Cube.

roadmap.title: Endgame systems
roadmap.description: Torment difficulties, Undercity, the Dark Citadel, Echo of Lilith, and the monster-family counts.

roadmap.title: Final grinds
roadmap.description: Paragon 200 and 300, and the Torment XII and Echoing Hatred Elite counts.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Bandits, Cultists, or Knights.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Bandits, Cultists, or Knights in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count.

steps.text: Kill Bandits, Cultists, and Knights until the total reaches 666. Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, and Whispers have many.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies while Berserking as a Barbarian.
achievements.summary: As a Barbarian, kill 50 enemies while Berserking.

steps.text: Make a Barbarian. Choose a skill or upgrade that gives you @mechanic{Berserking}.
Defeat 50 foes during the time your Berserking effect is active.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign.
achievements.summary: Finish the base game's campaign, including its epilogue.

steps.text: Play the Prologue and Acts I to VI. Act VI ends with the fight against @enemy{Lilith} in the Cathedral of Hatred.
Keep going into the Epilogue: do @mechanic{Promises}, @mechanic{A Heavy Burden}, and @mechanic{Legacy of the Horadrim}.
At @loc{Firebreak Manor}, finish the last conversation with @npc{Lorath} at the grave and watch the cutscene. The achievement unlocks after it.

achievements.description: Imprint 10 items at the Occultist with an Aspect from the Codex of Power.
achievements.summary: Imprint a Codex of Power Aspect on 10 items at the Occultist.

steps.text: Earn at least one Aspect for your @mechanic{Codex of Power}, for example by finishing a dungeon.
Collect 10 cheap Rare items or spare Legendary items of a type that Aspect fits. The Codex shows which items it fits.
Visit the @npc{Occultist} and put a Codex Aspect onto 10 different items, one at a time.

achievements.description: Craft any Elixir and any Incense.
achievements.summary: Craft any Elixir and any Incense.

steps.text: At the @npc{Alchemist}, craft one @item{Elixir} and one @item{Incense} from the recipes shown as available.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Demons, Fallen, or Goatmen.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Demons, Fallen, or Goatmen in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count.

steps.text: Kill Demons, Fallen, and Goatmen until the total reaches 666. Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, and Whispers have many.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Drowned, Vampires, or Werewolves.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Drowned, Vampires, or Werewolves in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count.

steps.text: Kill Drowned, Vampires, and Werewolves until the total reaches 666. Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, and Whispers have many.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies in Werebear form and 50 enemies in Werewolf form as a Druid.
achievements.summary: Playing a Druid, get 50 kills while shapeshifted into a Werebear and 50 more as a Werewolf.

steps.text: Make a Druid. Land 50 killing blows with Werebear skills, such as @mechanic{Pulverize}.
Land 50 killing blows with Werewolf skills, such as @mechanic{Shred}.

achievements.description: Explore all of Estuar.
achievements.summary: Explore every area of the Estuar map.

guide.context: Some areas can only be reached through the campaign, so finish the story first. Side quests, altars, and dungeons are not needed unless they open a gated area.

steps.text: Open the map and check Region Progress for the five Estuar regions: Fractured Peaks, Scosglen, Dry Steppes, Kehjistan, and Hawezar. A missing tile reads @warn{Undiscovered} when you hover over it.

Walk into each missing tile. Commonly missed spots: Virtue's Point, Altar of Martyrdom, Heretic's Flight, the tiny shrine nooks along the Pilgrimage path, and, in Fractured Peaks, the passage to the southeast of Bear Tribe Refuge.
Also check the north coast of Scosglen, the western cliffs of the Dry Steppes, the west coast and Caldeum edge of Kehjistan, and the east coast and narrow Plaguemarsh paths in Hawezar.
If every region shows complete but the achievement stays locked, rediscover every base-game area on a new Hardcore character.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Ghosts, Skeletons, or Zombies.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Ghosts, Skeletons, or Zombies in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count.

steps.text: Kill Ghosts, Skeletons, and Zombies until the total reaches 666. Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, and Whispers have many.

achievements.description: Collect 1000 Aberrant Cinder in Helltide zones.
achievements.summary: Collect 1000 Aberrant Cinders in Helltide zones.

guide.context: Spending Aberrant Cinders does not lower your progress. Helltides open after the campaign.

steps.text: Play inside Helltide zones, earning @item{Aberrant Cinders} from monsters and events, until your lifetime total hits 1000.

achievements.description: Reach Level 50 with any character.
achievements.summary: Get any one character to Level 50.

steps.text: Level one character to 50. Playing the campaign gets you there.

achievements.description: Reach Level 50 with a Hardcore character.
achievements.summary: Get a Hardcore character to Level 50.

guide.context: Dying deletes a Hardcore character. If yours dies, start a new one.

steps.text: Start a new Seasonal Hardcore character and pick Normal or Hard difficulty. A sturdy class helps.
Gain levels through low-risk content: Whispers, world events, and Helltides that are weaker than your character. Quit the game immediately if your connection lags.
Stop at Level 50. Nothing further is needed.

achievements.description: Reach Paragon Level 200 with any character.
achievements.summary: Get any one character to Paragon Level 200.

guide.context: Paragon levels start once a character reaches the level cap, and they are shared across your characters.

steps.text: Cycle through War Plans, Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, Whispers, the Undercity, and Infernal Hordes on a high Torment setting. Keep an Elixir and Incense running.

achievements.description: Summon 100 Skeleton Mages or Warriors as a Necromancer.
achievements.summary: As a Necromancer, summon 100 Skeletal Warriors or Skeletal Mages.

steps.text: Make a Necromancer and equip @mechanic{Raise Skeleton}.
Raise skeleton Warriors and Mages from corpses over and over, replacing old ones, until your lifetime count of summons hits 100.

achievements.description: Complete a Nightmare Dungeon in Torment 2 or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete a Nightmare Dungeon on Torment II or higher.

guide.context: You unlock Torment difficulties by clearing Pit tiers.

steps.text: Clear Pit tiers until Torment II is open. Set your world difficulty to Torment II or higher.
Activate any Nightmare Dungeon sigil and finish the dungeon.

achievements.description: Use your Healing Potion 1,000 times.
achievements.summary: Drink a Healing Potion 1,000 times.

steps.text: Drink your potion whenever you are hurt, instead of waiting for a pickup.
To finish faster at endgame, stand in mild damage near a safe checkpoint and keep drinking until you reach 1,000.

achievements.description: Get 5 PvP kills.
achievements.summary: Get 5 PvP kills.

guide.context: You need another player to kill. Avoid Hardcore for this.

steps.text: Enter a Fields of Hatred zone and use the @mechanic{Mark for Blood} action.
Kill other players five times. A friend can come back after each death. Killing the same player counts.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies in melee range and 50 enemies out of melee range as a Rogue.
achievements.summary: Playing a Rogue, get 50 kills at close range and 50 kills at long range.

steps.text: Make a Rogue. Kill 50 enemies up close with @mechanic{Flurry} or @mechanic{Twisting Blades}.
Take down 50 enemies at a distance using @mechanic{Penetrating Shot} or @mechanic{Rapid Fire}.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Snakes or Spiders.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Snakes or Spiders in any combination.

guide.context: Snakes and Spiders share one count.

steps.text: Kill Snakes and Spiders until the total reaches 666. Nightmare Dungeons, Helltides, and Whispers have many.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies with Fire, Frost, or Lightning damage as a Sorcerer.
achievements.summary: Playing a Sorcerer, get 100 kills using Fire, Frost, or Lightning damage.

steps.text: Make a Sorcerer. Using Campaign Skip on the easiest difficulty saves time, once you have earned the campaign achievements.
Use skills whose tooltip shows Fire, Frost, or Lightning damage, such as @mechanic{Chain Lightning}, in busy fights until 100 enemies have died to them.

achievements.description: Defeat the Echo of Lilith.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Echo of Lilith.

guide.context: You need Torment I or higher. The fight has two phases.

steps.text: Pick the lowest Torment tier that makes the entrance appear, then head to the Echo of Hatred dungeon next to @loc{Nevesk}, in the Desolate Highlands.
Phase one: stay out of the sweeping wave lines and away from orbs that pile on a stacking debuff.
Phase two: keep hopping to whichever platform is still safe while @enemy{Lilith} breaks up the arena. Win both phases.

achievements.description: Temper a piece of Armor, Jewelry, and a Weapon.
achievements.summary: Temper one armor piece, one jewelry piece, and one weapon.

steps.text: Visit the @npc{Blacksmith} and Temper three items: an armor piece, a jewelry piece, and a weapon.

achievements.description: Acquire 10 Caches of Chaos from the Tree of Whispers.
achievements.summary: Take 10 Caches of Chaos as rewards at the Tree of Whispers.

guide.context: The Tree only sometimes offers a Cache of Chaos, so it can take many turn-ins.

steps.text: Turn in 10 @item{Grim Favors} at the @npc{Tree of Whispers} to claim a reward.
When a Cache of Chaos is offered, choose it and open it.
Repeat until you have taken 10 Caches of Chaos.

achievements.description: Kill any World Boss.
achievements.summary: Kill any World Boss.

steps.text: Check the map for a World Boss marker. Travel to the arena before its timer runs out and help kill the boss.

achievements.description: Complete the Vessel of Hatred campaign.
achievements.summary: Finish the Vessel of Hatred campaign.

steps.text: Begin with @mechanic{Rekindled Faith} in @loc{Kyovashad}. If that quest is not there, create a new character who starts at Vessel of Hatred, or pick that campaign from the character menu.
Play Chapters I to IV: Kyovashad and Nahantu, Kurast, Wekenga and the Spirit Realm, then Samuk and Akarat's Tomb.
Last quest, @mechanic{Presaging Fate}: go back to the @loc{Windswept Cabin}, talk to @npc{Prava}, then @npc{Neyrelle}, and sit through the ending.

achievements.description: Complete the Rise of the Khazra Dark Citadel.
achievements.summary: Clear the three wings of the Dark Citadel called Rise of the Khazra.

guide.context: You need a party of 2 to 4 players. Once per account, each player does the feature quest that opens it.

steps.text: Once Vessel of Hatred is done, switch to any Torment difficulty and find @npc{Priestess Cualli}, who waits to the southwest, near the difficulty statue in Upper Kurast, and accept her quest @mechanic{Crater of Lost Souls}.
Check out @loc{Raider's Breach}, defeat everything in the @loc{Ancient Nexus}, then turn on its Waypoint.
Finish each wing in turn: @loc{Enclave of Strife}, @loc{Labyrinth of Souls}, and @loc{Dominion of Zagraal}.
After the last wing, collect the overall Rise of the Khazra completion.

achievements.description: Explore all of Nahantu.
achievements.summary: Explore every area of the Nahantu map.

guide.context: Nahantu has 58 areas. Side quests and dungeons are not needed.

steps.text: Open the map. Hover over each tile that reads @warn{Undiscovered} and walk into it.
Cover Five Hills, Seven Stones, Restless Canopy, Field of Giants, Teganze Plateau, Lingering Hatred, and Kurast Docks.
Enter the outer edge of the three strongholds: Kichuk, The Festering Dark, and Chakhir.

achievements.description: Collect 10,000 Aberrant Cinders in Nahantu Helltides.
achievements.summary: Earn 10,000 Aberrant Cinders from Helltides that take place in Nahantu.

guide.context: Only Helltides whose zone lies in Nahantu count toward this.

steps.text: Join Helltide events and Blood Maiden fights only while the Helltide zone is in Nahantu. Keep going until the total reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Reach level 10 with all Mercenaries.
achievements.summary: Raise all four Mercenaries to level 10.

guide.context: Each Mercenary levels through Rapport. Alone you can bring two along; in a group, only one.

steps.text: Unlock @npc{Raheir} by finishing @mechanic{The Hand Remembers the Blade} in the campaign.
Unlock @npc{Varyana} with @mechanic{Slayer's Retribution}, @npc{Aldkin} with @mechanic{A Nameless Mystery}, and @npc{Subo} with @mechanic{A Feather on the Scale}.
Always have a Mercenary hired and a Reinforcement posted. Each gains Rapport, though the Reinforcement gains it slower.
Swap in the Mercenary with the lowest Rapport until all four reach level 10.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Dregs, Lacuni, or Hollows.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Dregs, Lacuni, or Hollows in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count.

steps.text: Kill Dregs, Lacuni, and Hollows in Nahantu until the total reaches 666.

achievements.description: Reach Paragon 300 with any character.
achievements.summary: Get any one character to Paragon Level 300.

guide.context: Paragon carries across seasons, so you can spread this over several.

steps.text: Keep running the same high-Torment activities as for Paragon 200 until you reach Paragon 300.

achievements.description: Kill 500 enemies with Ultimate Skills as a Spiritborn.
achievements.summary: As a Spiritborn, kill 500 enemies with Ultimate Skills.

steps.text: Make a Spiritborn and unlock an Ultimate Skill at Level 20. The Hunter's Ultimate works well on dense packs.
Keep casting it until Ultimate Skills have killed 500 enemies.

achievements.description: Defeat 1000 Elites on Torment IV.
achievements.summary: Defeat 1000 Elites on Torment IV.

guide.context: You unlock Torment IV by clearing Pit tiers.

steps.text: Switch the world to Torment IV and hunt Elites in Nightmare Dungeons, Helltide events, the Undercity, and Infernal Hordes until you reach the 1000 mark.

achievements.description: Complete 25 runs of the Kurast Undercity.
achievements.summary: Finish 25 Kurast Undercity runs.

guide.context: The Undercity opens after the Vessel of Hatred story quest Reunion.

steps.text: Once @mechanic{Reunion} is done, talk to @npc{Ormus} and do these four priority quests in sequence: @mechanic{Undercity: Wail of the Forgotten}, @mechanic{Undercity: The Specter of Travincal}, @mechanic{Undercity: The Promise}, and @mechanic{Undercity: Starving Pride}.
In each run, kill Afflicted enemies to gain time. Light Spirit Beacons only if you have plenty of time left on the clock.
Reach the boss portal and kill the boss. Do 25 successful runs.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 Elites in Torment XII.
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 Elites on Torment XII.

guide.context: You unlock Torment XII by clearing Pit tiers.

steps.text: Switch the world to Torment XII and hunt Elites in short Nightmare Dungeons and crowded War Plans until you reach 1000.

achievements.description: Explore all of Skovos.
achievements.summary: Explore every area of the Skovos map.

guide.context: Skovos has 65 areas. Finish Lord of Hatred first so every story gate is open.

steps.text: Open the map and cover Skartara, Celestia, Atanos, Athulua, Lycander, and Philios, walking into every @warn{Undiscovered} tile.
Enter the outer edge of all three strongholds.

Do not skip @loc{The Wishing Wall}: a very small ledge in Skartara, southeast of the Cataclysm dungeon, that you reach by jumping across a gap. One final tile may only register inside the Mephisto story arena.

If all 65 areas show complete but the achievement stays locked, use a character from the other mode (Hardcore if you used Softcore, or the reverse), set Lord of Hatred to @mechanic{Not Started}, play the campaign again, and uncover all 65 areas on that character.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 Bosses/Elites in the Echoing Hatred.
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 Bosses or Elites inside Echoing Hatred.

guide.context: Kills add up across all your runs. Each run uses one Trace of Echoes. You can also join other players' runs from the group finder.

steps.text: Farm Elites and Champions until a rare @item{Trace of Echoes} drops. A priority quest then sends you to the @loc{Sightless Eye} in @loc{Temis}, where you give it the Trace.
Bring an area-damage build. Take out gold Elites and bosses before anything else, and keep draining the Overwhelm bar. Try to last as many waves as possible; the cap is 150.
Repeat, or join group-finder runs, until 1000 Bosses and Elites have died inside Echoing Hatred.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies with your Demonology skills.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with Demonology skills.

guide.context: Demonology is a Warlock skill tag.

steps.text: Make a Warlock. Pick @mechanic{Dread Claws} and check that its tooltip shows the Demonology tag.
Kill 100 enemies with Dread Claws or other Demonology skills.

achievements.description: Complete the Lord of Hatred campaign.
achievements.summary: Finish the Lord of Hatred campaign.

guide.context: Play it after the Vessel of Hatred campaign.

steps.text: Play Chapters I to V: Temis, Philios and Athulua, Atanos and Celestia, Skartara and the Horadric Vault, then the Birthplace.
Defeat @enemy{Mephisto} at the Birthplace in @mechanic{Lord of Hatred}, then speak to @npc{Tyrael}.
Chapter VI has one quest, @mechanic{No Gods, No Masters}. Meet @npc{Tyrael} beside the @loc{Tree of Whispers}, grab the torch, set the tree alight, and sit through the closing scenes.

achievements.description: Collect all the fish in one region.
achievements.summary: Collect every fish of one region.

guide.context: Fishing becomes available once you finish the Lord of Hatred quest The Queen and the Saint. Every Skovos fish can come from any Skovos fishing spot. The drops are random, so plan on a few hours. To start, travel to Temis, follow the shore eastward to Shi Yugong's Haven, finish the quest Fishing, and put Cast Fishing Line on your action wheel. Fish from the safe pier there. Press a skill button the moment the fish icon appears; a perfect press yields two catches. Use each catch from the Consumables tab, and trade spare duplicates if one fish refuses to drop.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Golems, Merfolk, or Morlu.
achievements.summary: Kill 666 Golems, Merfolk, or Morlu in any combination.

guide.context: These three enemy types share one count. Skovos quests give plenty of all three.

steps.text: Kill Golems, Merfolk, and Morlu through the Skovos story. If you are short, farm the open coasts and Skartara until the total reaches 666.

achievements.description: Activate a Charm Set's 5-piece bonus.
achievements.summary: Activate the 5-piece bonus of a Charm Set.

guide.context: Enemies and War Plan rewards drop Set Charms, and they appear more often from Torment III on. You can reroll a Set Charm in the Horadric Cube.

steps.text: The quest @mechanic{Last of the Horadrim} in Lord of Hatred gives you the @item{Horadric Seal}. Equip a Seal that has five or more Charm slots.
Fill five of its slots with Set Charms that all belong to one named set.

achievements.description: Equip a piece of Transfigured gear in every slot.
achievements.summary: Wear Transfigured gear in every equipment slot at once.

guide.context: Do not use your best gear to experiment.

steps.text: Finish the follow-up priority quest after the @item{Horadric Cube} so it works in @loc{Temis}.
Use spare Legendary items to apply @mechanic{Transfiguration} to a piece for every equipment slot.
Equip all of the Transfigured pieces at the same time.

achievements.description: Complete 10 War Plans.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 War Plans.

guide.context: War Plans unlock after the Lord of Hatred credits.

steps.text: When the credits end, do the @mechanic{Horadric Cube} quest in the middle of @loc{Temis}, then take @mechanic{The War for Sanctuary} from @npc{Tyrael}.
At the @mechanic{Command Table} in Temis, select the available activities and finish every one you chose.
Claim the @item{War Chest}. Repeat until you have fully claimed 10 War Plans.
